title: Founders@Google Presents: The Cultural Anthropology of Stack Exchange
summary: Joel Spolsky's 2012 Google tech talk on the cultural anthropology of Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange. He explains how the software was designed to shape community norms and curation standards.
why: HN points to it to explain that Stack Overflow's strict moderation was deliberate design, not accident.

quote.text: If you want to hear more about this you should watch Joel Spolsky's talk
